name: The Barcelona EDITION
positioning: Ian Schrager-designed city-center hotel (official name The Barcelona EDITION) beside the Picasso Museum and the Santa Caterina Market, with a 10th-floor rooftop terrace and pool
best_for: Travelers who want to explore the old town on foot

facts.text: The hotel is beside the Picasso Museum and the Barcelona Gothic Cathedral, adjacent to the Santa Caterina Market.
More than 15 Barcelona sights and historic landmarks are within walking distance of the hotel.
The hotel's design is by Ian Schrager.
The Roof is a rooftop terrace on the 10th floor of the hotel.
The Roof has a small urban outdoor pool with panoramic views.
Punch Room is a speakeasy-inspired cocktail lounge reached by a spiral staircase, serving specialty punches in vintage silver bowls.
Veraz is a restaurant and bar with a wall of 410 backlit liquor bottles.
Bathrooms are finished in white Sivec marble with brass hardware.
The hotel has two penthouses, each with a private terrace.
Multiple connecting rooms and suites are available for families.
The gym is open 24 hours and free for guests to use.

highlights.text: The Roof is a rooftop terrace on the 10th floor of the hotel.
Punch Room is a speakeasy-inspired cocktail lounge reached by a spiral staircase, serving specialty punches in vintage silver bowls.
Some rooms have views over the Santa Caterina Market roof.
Veraz focuses on seasonal market ingredients from the neighbouring Santa Caterina Market.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the urban setting may be busy for those seeking tranquility.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting its luxury positioning.
Parking is available at SABA on Francesc Cambo Street, just in front of the hotel.
